title: Faithful 3D GenyCaster logo
changes: The Setup GPU brand now uses the exact white G and gray directional arrow contours from the official GenyCaster SVG, not approximate circles and triangles.
Preserve the official front silhouette and colors while keeping native GPU depth, subtle bevels, light/dark themes, pointer drag and automatic rotation.
Improve edge-distance sampling so the contours remain cleaner when rotated sideways.
